roster.name: KuiperSat prototypes
roster.note: two test satellites reach orbit to validate the design before mass production begins

roster.name: Production launches
roster.note: the operational constellation begins deploying — years behind Starlink, and racing a regulatory clock to keep its spectrum

roster.name: Multi-rocket by design
roster.note: Kuiper buys launches across many providers — Atlas V, Vulcan, Ariane 6, New Glenn — rather than depending on a rival's rocket the way it would on Falcon
